newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 7.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- U.S. Secretary of Defence William Cohen vows to maintain 100,000 U.S. troops in East Asia after Korean reunification.
-- Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd plans to tie up with Apple Computer Inc for digital camera.
-- William Cohen says that U.S. will keep 47,000 troops in Okinawa after stability returns to Korean Peninsula.
-- APEC finance ministers see macroeconomic policy as vital to foreign exchange stability.
-- Direct dialogue between government and rebels over Lima hostage standoff will be resumed as early as this week.
-- APEC finance ministers have agreed to stimulate the use of private funds in improving the region's social infrastructure and developing its financial and capital markets.
-- Lower House plans to open deliberations on revision of U.S. bases land law today, and will likely approve it this week.
